metadata.description: MCP server for InSync Healthcare (Qualifacts) patient portals — read appointments, medications, allergies, messages, forms and balance, download portal files, and upload an insurance card (confirm-gated). Signs in server-side with the portal password, or relays requests through the user's signed-in browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

plugins.name: insync-mcp
plugins.description: Access an InSync Healthcare (Qualifacts) patient portal — read appointments, medications, allergies, messages, forms and balance, download files, and upload an insurance card (confirm-gated) — by signing in server-side or relaying through the user's signed-in browser tab.
